page.overview:
What is Narath?

Narath is a fictional city created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "The Silver Key".

Located somewhere in the Dreamlands, Narath is described as a city of peerless beauty with a hundred carven gates and domes of chalcedony. (: "The Silver Key")
